title: Noise of a function with small stable influences
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, let $\varepsilon\in\mathbb R$, and let $g:\{-1,1\}^n\to[-1,1]$. The function $g$ is the noise transform at parameter $\rho$ of some function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to[-1,1]$ whose stable influences are small with both parameters equal to $\varepsilon$.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the property of having small stable influences.
